# One line per hook: <target-relative-path> <snippet-file> <marker>
# The snippet is spliced into the target between "# RED-OVERLAY:BEGIN <marker>"
# and "# RED-OVERLAY:END <marker>". Re-applying replaces the block, so apply is
# idempotent and re-triggerable after an upstream submodule bump.
